title: SoakMutationSelection
description: Defines held-out mutations of a scenario used to guard against overfitting. Final acceptance is measured on a held-out mutation selected at runtime; the selection seed is drawn from the gitignored eval-runs tree so the held-out choice is not baked into the committed manifest.

transform.description: Public-safe description of how the prompt/artifacts are perturbed (e.g. 'swap workload numbers and reorder defects').

preserves_correct_answer.description: True if the mutation keeps the same correct answer; false mutations must flip expected grading.

held_out.description: Eligible to be chosen as the held-out acceptance mutation.

seed_source.description: The selection seed is drawn from the gitignored eval-runs tree, not committed.
